method: Same helper, Chrome build, viewport 1440 × 1000 / DPR 1, warm assets, three-second normalized hero start-to-end scroll. Final runs executed sequentially.
limitations: Single local headless Chrome run per source, without CPU throttling.
The section changed from 340svh to 300svh, so normalized animations cover 2400px before and 2000px after over the same three seconds.
rAF intervals indicate scheduling, not measured compositor FPS or human trackpad latency.
Trace Paint duration does not include all GPU raster cost. Paint duration and total TaskDuration did not improve, even though the observed frame interval p95 and style/script CPU improved.
Final source adds a separate 1800 × 800 closeup image surface for initial photo sharpness. Its resource cost is included in the final after measurement.
Host load can vary; results are not a performance guarantee for other devices.
